title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
overview: A Cloud DevOps Engineer bridges the gap between software development and infrastructure operations. They automate software release pipelines, configure infrastructure as code (IaC), ensure cloud scalability and security, and monitor high-availability production environments across cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
education_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent hands-on experience

entry_level.title: Junior DevOps Engineer / Cloud Associate
entry_level.focus: Writing CI/CD automation scripts, Docker containerization, basic cloud resource provisioning.

mid_level.title: DevOps Engineer / Platform Engineer
mid_level.focus: Kubernetes cluster administration, Terraform infrastructure as code, cloud monitoring, observability.

senior_level.title: Senior Cloud Architect / Principal SRE
senior_level.focus: Multi-cloud architecture, zero-downtime release strategies, disaster recovery, cloud cost optimization.

required_technical_skills: Linux Systems Administration and Bash Scripting
Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform)
Scripting and Automation with Python or Go
career_roadmap: Step 1: Master Linux command line, networking fundamentals, and Git version control.
Step 2: Learn Docker to containerize fullstack applications.
Step 3: Setup CI/CD automation pipelines using GitHub Actions to build and test code.
Step 4: Learn a major cloud provider (AWS or GCP) and provision resources using Terraform.
Step 5: Master Kubernetes fundamentals and deploy microservices with Helm.
Step 6: Earn AWS Solutions Architect Associate or CKA certification and publish infrastructure repos.
source: NextStep Career Knowledge Base - Cloud Engineering Domain v1.0
